races.verdict: POWER OF KNOWLEDGE is bred to be an above-average prospect and, with his recent bumper debut under his belt, looks to have been found a good opportunity to make a winning start over hurdles. Midfield Magic shaped well on debut for Tom Dreaper and should have more to offer now with Gavin Cromwell, while Tomthescaffolder is also capable of being involved if bouncing back from an odds-on defeat last time. POWER OF KNOWLEDGE (IRE) MIDFIELD MAGIC (IRE) TOMTHESCAFFOLDER

races.verdict: GOEASYONME was unfancied on debut but shaped with enough promise to suggest he is capable of landing an ordinary maiden, and this looks just such an opportunity. GOEASYONME (FR) COMBS (IRE) TEXAS RED (FR)

races.verdict: MWAFAQ remains on an upward curve and shaped like the best horse at the weights when an unlucky fifth at Lingfield 2 weeks ago, so he is taken to resume winning ways at the chief expense of Iain Jardine's Southwell winner Junkyard Dog and top-weight Shimmering Sands . MWAFAQ (IRE) JUNKYARD DOG (IRE) SHIMMERING SANDS

races.verdict: ASADJUMEIRAH gained his sixth C&D victory in July and, having run creditably here last time, he could be up to adding to his tally. Liquid Cooled looks an interesting contender, though, back at the scene of his handicap debut success, with last-time-out winner Dream Forever also considered. ASADJUMEIRAH LIQUID COOLED (IRE) DREAM FOREVER (IRE)

races.display_title: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict: VIRTUE PATIENCE 's sole success came on the back of a break and Amanda Perrett's 4-y-o gets the vote to repeat that feat returning from 3 months off here. Prince Rasam looked well suited by 1m when runner-up at Kempton back in May, so he heads up the opposition also returning from an absence, with Decalogue rounding off the shortlist after an improved effort at Newmarket last time. VIRTUE PATIENCE PRINCE RASAM DECALOGUE (USA)

races.verdict: A valuable fillies' maiden which can go the way of THI QAR , who shaped with plenty of encouragement when runner-up at Newmarket on debut last month and John & Thady Gosden's filly is sure to have derived plenty from that initial effort.
